commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Ashnod ({2}{U}{B}{R} 1/4 deathtouch) copies every non-mana activated ability of an artifact or creature whose cost sacrificed a permanent, with new targets and no once-per-turn limit (the tracker's 'once-per-turn' note is stale versus current Oracle). The deck is built from cheap sacrifice-cost artifacts (Spellbombs, Skullbomb, Baubles, Mind Stone, Mnemonic Sphere), sacrifice engines (Trading Post, Repurposing Bay, Kuldotha Forgemaster, Time Sieve, Bolas's Citadel, Treasure Vault, Retrofitter Foundry, Goblin Engineer, Scrap Welder), recursion (Scrap Trawler, Myr Retriever, Academy Ruins, Emry) and death payoffs (Disciple, Marionette Apprentice, Mayhem Devil), plus independent combos (Trawler/Retriever/KCI or Altar + reducer, Nim Deathmantle lines, Dross Scorpion + Retrofitter).
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 - Optimized: six Game Changers (Ancient Tomb, Bolas's Citadel, Cyclonic Rift, Demonic Tutor, Fierce Guardianship, Vampiric Tutor), multiple infinite combos already in the baseline; not cEDH-tuned (no Mana Crypt/Dockside/Thassa's Oracle package; five-mana commander).
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Every add has a sacrifice-cost ability Ashnod copies or is a Spellbook-verified Ashnod combo piece; two adds (Corridor Monitor, Thopter Squadron) are off-ranking. Generic artifact goodstuff with non-sacrifice abilities (Skullclamp, Keys, Walking Ballista) was rejected or cut.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: All 99 reviewed by quantity (95 source rows, 100 physical cards): 33 lands (25 nonbasic incl. Urza's Saga, four artifact lands and Treasure Vault; Island x3, Mountain x2, Swamp x3), 9 static rocks, 43 artifacts, 25 creatures, Clan Crafter (Background). Overlaps: three artifact cost reducers (Inspector/Sculptor/Mechanaut), nine rocks, and several cards whose abilities have no sacrifice cost (Walking Ballista, Fellwar, Talismans, Foundry Inspector) and so ignore the commander.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Baseline 33 lands + 9 rocks; nonland curve 0:4 1:13 2:24 3:18 4:5 5:1 6:1. Candidate 33 lands + 7 rocks (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Mind Stone, Talisman of Creativity, Talisman of Dominance, Mox Opal, Lotus Petal) plus Ancient Tomb, Treasure Vault and Crime Novelist/KCI/Altar mana; nonland curve 0:3 1:14 2:24 3:17 4:5 5:2 6:1 (average +0.05). Artifact count 43 -> 41, creature count 25 -> 27. Coloured pips added: Corridor Monitor {1}{U}, Audacious Reshapers {2}{R}, Priest {1}{B} (Spellbomb and Squadron are colourless; the bounce mode costs {U}); all five cuts were colourless, so colour requirements rise slightly while 33 lands supply each colour.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Stack: Mana Drain, Fierce Guardianship, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Deflecting Swat; removal: Executioner's Capsule, Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift, Vandalblast, Toxic Deluge, Pyrite Spellbomb, Krark-Clan Shaman, Otawara, Blasting Station; candidate adds Aether Spellbomb bounce (doubled) and Priest's doubled edicts, loses Walking Ballista pings. Recursion vs artifact wipes: Academy Ruins, Emry, Trawler, Retriever, Engineer, Welder, Trading Post.

material_candidates.source: OFF-RANKING: not on the Ashnod EDHREC page (3205 decks); found via Commander Spellbook almost-included combo 1414-1649-2068-4404 and an untap-effect Oracle search; live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: 2-mana artifact creature whose ETB untaps an artifact or creature; combo piece and engine re-use
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses the third artifact cost reducer; Etherium Sculptor and Enthusiastic Mechanaut stay, so every Trawler/Retriever reducer line still exists (two of 15 Spellbook variants disappear, none of the underlying lines).
material_candidates.commander_synergy: New Ashnod-only infinite: with a non-summoning-sick Goblin Engineer and Lotus Petal in the graveyard, activate Engineer (R from Petal, sacrifice Monitor) targeting Petal; Ashnod copies the ability and the copy targets Monitor; Monitor returns and untaps Engineer, then Petal returns; repeat for infinite artifact sacrifices/ETBs/deaths (Disciple, Marionette Apprentice, Mayhem Devil, Reckless Fireweaver, Crime Novelist mana). Outside the loop it untaps Time Sieve, Kuldotha Forgemaster, Bolas's Citadel, Blasting Station or Engineer/Welder after Trawler/Retriever/Engineer/Welder return it.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Loop needs Engineer to have been under control since turn start and Petal in the graveyard; a 1/1 body alone; graveyard hate (Rest in Peace) breaks the loop.
material_candidates.reason: Commander-specific infinite with pieces already in the 99 plus flexible untap value; best replacement for a redundant reducer.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Ashnod page (1992/3205 decks, 62%); live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: 1-mana artifact with two sacrifice abilities: bounce a creature or cycle
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses the opponent-dependent ninth rock; 33 lands + 7 rocks + Treasure Vault/Offer Treasures remain.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Both abilities sacrifice the Spellbomb as a cost, so Ashnod copies them: {U} bounces two creatures (opposing blockers/hatebears, or our own Corridor Monitor/Myr Retriever for re-use) and {1} draws two cards. Cheap Urza's Saga target (MV1), Goblin Engineer/Scrap Trawler recursion fodder.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Bounce is tempo, not removal; small effect without Ashnod in play.
material_candidates.reason: A cheap artifact that becomes two cards or two bounces whenever the commander is out; better use of the slot than a conditional rock.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Ashnod page (1141/3205, 36%); live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: 3-mana creature: tap, sacrifice an artifact: put the next artifact from the library onto the battlefield
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses the third Talisman (B/R also from Talisman of Creativity/Dominance colours, Arcane Signet, Mox Opal, Lotus Petal and 33 lands).
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Sacrifice is part of the cost, so Ashnod copies it: one Treasure/Servo/Bauble becomes two random artifacts from a library that is ~41% artifacts, including free Bolas's Citadel, Kuldotha Forgemaster, KCI, Thopter Squadron.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Damage to us equals cards revealed (about 2-3 per reveal, doubled with the copy); random hits; tap ability is summoning-sick.
material_candidates.reason: Card advantage and tempo directly multiplied by the commander; acceptable self-damage in a deck with Trading Post/Inventors' Fair life gain.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Ashnod page (672/3205, 21%); live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: 2-mana sacrifice engine: drain, edict, BB and a card
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Walking Ballista: an X-mana sink/outlet for infinite colorless mana and an x/1 pinger; Ballista's abilities never sacrifice, so Ashnod never copies them.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Sacrificing two creatures is the cost, so Ashnod copies: each targeted opponent loses 4 life and sacrifices two creatures, and we add BBBB and draw two. Fodder is plentiful (Servos, Thopters, Scrap, Constructs, Myr Retriever, Corridor Monitor, Scrap Trawler).
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Needs two other creatures; instant-speed only; tapped ability so one use per turn without untaps; infinite-mana lines now rely on Disciple/Apprentice/Devil/Blasting Station instead of Ballista.
material_candidates.reason: Converts the deck's token fodder into an Ashnod-doubled edict/drain/ramp/draw engine; Ballista is generic and unexploited by the commander.

material_candidates.source: OFF-RANKING: not on the Ashnod EDHREC page; found via Commander Spellbook almost-included combos 2034-2068-2762-5346 and 2068-2762-4659-5346; live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: 5-mana artifact creature: makes Thopters from counters and eats Thopters for counters
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Esoteric Duplicator (43% EDHREC): its {2}-sac draw is also copied by Ashnod and its pay-{2} copy tokens are slow value, but it is not a combo piece.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Second Ashnod-only infinite: Squadron's '{1}, sacrifice another Thopter: +1/+1 counter' is copied, so each Thopter returns two counters. With Crime Novelist (R per artifact sacrifice) and Ashnod's Altar or KCI, a cycle of two Thopters nets +1 mana and keeps counters level (sorcery speed): infinite colourless/red mana, Thopter ETB/LTB and death triggers. Without the combo, it is three flying Thopters of fodder; Repurposing Bay (from a 4-MV artifact) and Kuldotha Forgemaster can fetch it.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Five mana; abilities are sorcery speed; needs Novelist + Altar/KCI for the infinite.
material_candidates.reason: Commander-specific combo using two pieces already in the 99 and solid fodder otherwise; Duplicator is value without a ceiling.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Five one-for-one swaps replace slots the commander cannot copy (a third reducer, two rocks, Walking Ballista, a slow Clue) with sacrifice-cost cards Ashnod doubles and two Ashnod-only infinite combos (Engineer + Monitor + Petal; Squadron + Novelist + Altar/KCI). Costs: rocks 9 -> 7, artifacts 43 -> 41, Walking Ballista's flexible sink/pings and Esoteric Duplicator's value leave, two Spellbook variants that used Foundry Inspector disappear (the lines survive via Sculptor/Mechanaut), Reshapers costs life. Gains: the commander becomes a combo piece and every add is doubled by it. Bracket stays 4 (the baseline already had infinite combos; new lines are 3-4 cards including the commander).

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Selected five-swap package: commander-copied adds and two new Ashnod combos replace slots the commander cannot use.

Five-swap alternative staged as full 100 (data/grixis/m7/research_challengers/Ashnod_the_Uncaring_five_alt_Priest_over_KrarkClanShaman_20261023.txt): Priest over Krark-Clan Shaman, keeping Walking Ballista; rejected because Pass C defended Shaman as the cheap Ashnod-doubled sweeper and Ballista is the weaker commander fit.
Six-swap alternative staged as full 100; retained as alternative, not clearly better.
Seven-swap alternative staged as full 100; both extra swaps are sidegrades.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Priest of Forgotten Gods was also tested over Krark-Clan Shaman (five-swap alternative data/grixis/m7/research_challengers/Ashnod_the_Uncaring_five_alt_Priest_over_KrarkClanShaman_20261023.txt, sha256 d1b79b0515ca956ff152fb8343df6d5f8ba1de512286d8e8388a373593614680); rejected in favour of cutting Walking Ballista because Pass C's KEEP specifically valued Shaman and Ballista's abilities are never copied.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: None of the baseline's 15 Spellbook combos uses Ashnod, and several slots (third reducer, opponent-dependent rock, third Talisman, Walking Ballista, Esoteric Duplicator) do nothing the commander can copy; the commander is a value engine rather than a combo piece.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Swap five commander-blind slots for sacrifice-cost cards and two Spellbook-verified Ashnod-only combo pieces whose other pieces are already in the 99.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: Exact copy of the physical canonical source order with five in-place substitutions; 33 lands, 7 rocks, 41 artifacts, 27 creatures, 100 physical cards verified by quantity.

owner_authority.owner_approval_question: This deck is complete. Do you approve it?

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: After the five, the remaining slots were re-challenged: engines (Citadel, Time Sieve, Forgemaster, Repurposing Bay, Trading Post, Retrofitter) and combo core (Trawler, Retriever, KCI, Altar, Novelist, Nim, Urza, Petal, Engineer) protected; payoffs (Disciple, Apprentice, Devil, Fireweaver, Anvil) kept; draw (Jhoira, Mnemonic Sphere, Dockside Chef, Skullbomb, Baubles) challenged with Sage, Fain, Skullclamp, Voltaic/Manifold Key; mana (Talismans, Exotic Orchard, Wayfarer's Bauble) challenged with Spire, Burnished Hart, Marionette Master; interaction (Krark-Clan Shaman, Toxic Deluge, Capsule) and top end (Forgemaster vs Mindslaver) rechecked.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Sage doubles with Ashnod for free draws, but Jhoira draws on every artifact cast without needing the commander; kept Jhoira and staged a six-swap full 100.
Spire is reliable any-colour with an artifact out but costs life and has no commander interaction; marginal, staged as six-swap full 100.
Bats is a fourth drain payoff at four mana; Shaman is the one-mana repeatable sweeper that Ashnod doubles and Pass C defended.
Cutting a seventh rock for a six-drop payoff would drop the mana floor below what a five-mana commander and BBB Citadel need.
Key only matters with Citadel already in play, where one copied activation already drains 20 per opponent; Bauble is free copied card draw and fodder.
Hart's copied search wants four basics from a list with only eight; Wayfarer costs one mana.
Skullclamp's equip is never copied by Ashnod while Skullbomb's two sacrifice modes are; incumbent fits the commander better.
Fain's modes are copied but each needs a tap and a {3}{B} untap; Chef is one mana and repeatable.
Mindslaver copy controls two turns but costs ten mana; Forgemaster puts Citadel/KCI/Squadron onto the battlefield.
Reversing the owner's most recent change is unjustified: Trading Post's copied sacrifice modes make goats into recursion and artifacts into cards.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Sage draws two for zero mana per artifact with Ashnod and is a cheap creature for Priest/Altar; it lowers the curve by two.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Jhoira draws on every artifact cast even when Ashnod is removed or not yet cast; with Ashnod absent Sage is a weak 1-for-1 outlet. Not clearly better.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Spire gives any colour as long as we control an artifact, independent of opponents' lands.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: No commander interaction; costs life every coloured activation; a marginal sidegrade that does not justify a sixth change.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Combines both staged improvements: more Ashnod-doubled draw and slightly steadier fixing.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Both component swaps are sidegrades on their own; stacking them adds change cost without a clear quality gain.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Stopped at five because every further challenger examined either needed the commander to beat an incumbent that works without it (Sage vs Jhoira), was a commander-blind sidegrade (Spire, Skullclamp), cut into the mana floor (Marionette Master, Courier's Capsule), was too narrow or expensive (Keys, Mindslaver, Burnished Hart) or reversed the owner's latest change (Commander's Sphere); none was clearly better than its incumbent.
